method: Each candidate uses edge (a TeX cross-reference inside a result or its proof, as listed in docs/graph/nodes.json) was classified by an AI critic reading the pinned source as proof-dependency, definition, comparison or wrong-target. An independent AI verifier re-checked all comparison and wrong-target verdicts, all edges the critic proposed as missing, and a seeded random sample of 40 other verdicts; its corrections are applied here. Edges added by review have no TeX cross-reference of their own and are marked source added-by-review. This record has not been reviewed by the authors of the monograph.

verdicts.proof-dependency: the proof or statement uses the target's statement or an argument stated there
verdicts.definition: the target supplies a definition, display or hypothesis used as setup
verdicts.comparison: a remark, analogy or heuristic first attempt; not a proof step
verdicts.wrong-target: the reference line does not refer to the target; excluded from every dependency use
